_comment: Changelog shown on updates.html. Newest first is not required — entries are sorted by date at render time. Add entries by hand. Tags: added | changed | fixed.

entries.title: Export pets rework
entries.body: Export pets has been reworked, with more control over what goes into your list and how it looks.
items: Export pets: more filters and display options, and a way to export exactly what the page is showing.
The spreadsheet export can be split up by category.
Various UI improvements.

entries.title: Update 80: Fall Event Part 2
entries.body: Added the Leaf Egg pets and the Chestnut Shop pets to the Acorns tab.
items: Acorns: Leaf Duck, Fall Serpent, Fall Mimic, Leaf Axolotl, Fall Shock, Leaf Griffin, Fallen Leaf (Leaf Egg).
Acorns: Chestnut Overlord, Tree Beast (Chestnut Shop).
Added the missing clicks for all pets.

entries.title: Grid view, API import, data fixes
entries.body: Grid view, a layout that mirrors the in-game index, is now the default view, and you can import your index from the Powerful Studio API.
items: Grid view: click a pet to tick it. Switch between Grid view and List view in the category header; filters and Undo work in both. Arrow keys move between pets, 1-4 switch variant, / focuses Search and Ctrl+Z undoes.

Import from game: use your Roblox username and an access token, from the first screen or Backup/Import > From game. Your in-game index is the source of truth, so ticks not in it are removed. Use the refresh icon next to the profile name to re-import. Imported profiles are locked by default; Settings > Your data can lock or unlock any profile.
Renamed Straw Dragon to Straw Golem.
Champion Tutel and The Prototype are now Ultimate. Royal Cat clicks are 3.5K.
Fixed percentages for Party Shield, Tiki Shield, 135M Dice, 25M Alien, Lovely Guardian, Adventure Immortal and Compass Overlord.

Export pets: list missing, owned or all pets, group by pet or variant, filter by variant and rarity, edit the list, and copy it or download it as text, a spreadsheet (paste into Google Sheets or Excel) or CSV. Spreadsheet and CSV have a column per variant, with a ✓ for what you have.
Filled in clicks for about 230 pets.

items: Added egg names for the Acorns pets (Acorn Egg, Orchard Egg, Fall 2026 Egg, Fall Stock Pack).

Acorns: Acorn Dog, Acorn Fox, Leaf Hedgehog, Apple Slime, Apple Bunny, Acorn Dragon, Orchard Deer, Apple Golem, Orchard Spirit, Autumn Spirit, Happy Leaf, Maple Cat, Autumn Heart, Maple Owl, Rain Dragon, Autumn Moth, Fall Phoenix, Autumn Kitsune, Maple Divinity, Acorn Blobfish, Fall Community Pet, Acorn Tutel.

Exclusives: Mushroom Snail, Toadstool Dragon, Mushroom Ghost, Toadstool Guardian, Mushroom King (Mushroom Exclusive Egg), Royal Trophy, Champion Tutel, Hedgehog Beast (Fall Pack), Autumn Lord (Fall Supporter Pack).
Fixed Interstellar Dragon being listed as Ultimate instead of Supreme. Thanks Vorticle!
Fixed Fairydust Dragon and Sakura Cat having their clicks swapped. Thanks hadam5!

items: Missing clicks amount for Core Overlord, will be added soon.

entries.title: Export sorting, Missing filter
entries.body: Export gained a Rarity sort, and a new Missing filter narrows the table to pets that still need one specific variant.
items: Export sort: Rarity now pools everything in scope by tier instead of by world.
Missing filter: show only pets still missing one variant, from Normal, Golden, Toxic, or Galaxy.
Season Exclusive Egg pets: previously blank egg names and clicks filled in. Thanks oliveboi08!

entries.title: All category
entries.body: Added an All tab that lists every pet from every world and category in one place. New profiles now open on it by default.

entries.title: Export list, keyboard navigation
entries.body: Added a way to export what you're still missing as a plain-text list, and the tick grid now supports full keyboard navigation.
items: Export pets: copy a list of what you still need, scoped to the whole index, one world, or your current filters.
Keyboard navigation: arrow keys, Home/End, and Enter now move focus around the grid.
Profile actions reorganised: Switch profile, Edit profile, Backup/Import, Export pets.

entries.title: Release
entries.body: Every pet in the game is indexed: 1,229 pets across 16 categories, 4,613 variants. Progress saves in your browser under a profile name, no login or account needed.
items: Clicks data is incomplete: 657 of 1,229 pets show a dash instead of a number. Missing data will be added in future updates.
